About Me

AI/ML Enthusiast & BSc Computing Student

I've always enjoyed solving math problems — it's the kind of thinking I genuinely find satisfying. When I realized that AI and ML are essentially applied mathematics — linear algebra, statistics, probability — it felt like a natural direction to move toward. That's what drew me in, and the more I explored it, the more it stuck.

I'm working toward becoming an AI Engineer and Data Scientist. I want to build systems that solve real problems with data — not just as a job, but because it's the kind of work I find meaningful.
